nativeProtocol.inputSupply: Continuous uranium ore enters only at the single west boundary belt. A private feeder alternates lanes at 15 items per second; no centrifuge or internal inventory is seeded.
nativeProtocol.outputCollection: Drain both east provider chests throughout the 15-minute warmup and one-second settlement interval, then count and clear all remaining warmup output from every output chest, machine, inserter and belt/splitter lane at the measurement boundary. Drain both east providers every simulated second during the 30-minute measured window; disable machines and flush any measured output still in transit separately.
nativeProtocol.power: External electric-energy-interface connected to the included medium-electric-pole network.
